hero.title: Plan days you can actually keep.
hero.subtitle: Your plan and what actually happened, in one timeline. See where they drift — and get better at planning. The lightest timeboxing tool for knowledge workers.

problem.title: You have a plan. You have a record. They just never meet.

separateApps.title: Work is scattered and that's okay
separateApps.description: Your tasks live in GitHub or Linear, your plans in your calendar, and your conversations in Slack. That's okay. But there is nowhere you decide how to use your time.

plansFallApart.title: Plan and record are in different places
plansFallApart.description: Your calendar shows future commitments, your tracker shows what happened. If they never meet, the drift is lost.

noReview.title: Reviewing is too much to keep up with
noReview.description: You know reflection matters, but if it requires a special ritual, you tend not to keep it up.

problem.closing: Dayopt is not a place to manage tasks. It is a place to operate how you use your time.

openByDesign.label: Open by design
openByDesign.title: Your data, open by design
openByDesign.subtitle: Your plans and records stay yours. Dayopt won't lock them in a closed box.
openByDesign.description: Connect your time data without changing your workflow.

mcp.title: MCP Server
mcp.description: Your AI assistant can directly access your plans and records in Dayopt.

ical.title: iCalendar feed
ical.description: You can subscribe to your Dayopt plans in Google Calendar and other tools.

api.title: API first
api.description: Data export and external integrations stay in your hands.

how.title: Your time. Planned, tracked, and understood.
how.subtitle: Your calendar plans. Your tracker records. Nothing connects the two. Dayopt brings it all into one timeline.

plan.title: Design your day
plan.description: Timebox your hours with drag & drop. Decide how you spend your time before the day decides for you.

track.title: See what actually happened
track.description: Plan and reality, side by side. Instantly see where your time went — and where it drifted.

learn.title: Get better at planning
learn.description: Dayopt turns the gap between plan and reality into simple insights. Your estimates get sharper week over week.
